title: pvHyperTreeGridToUnstructuredGrid
body:
## pvHyperTreeGridToUnstructuredGrid

Converts every leaf of a hyper tree grid into an explicit unstructured-grid cell (segments in 1-D, rectangles in 2-D, right hexahedra in 3-D) with the cell arrays kept. The result works with all standard filters but uses much more memory, and cells at different refinement levels meet at T-junctions (hanging nodes), so faces are not conformally connected. Use pvHyperTreeGridToDualGrid for a point-based dual mesh.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Because of T-junctions, connectivity and surface filters can see internal boundaries where refinement levels change.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `HyperTreeGridToUnstructuredGrid`. Identity: `filters/HyperTreeGridToUnstructuredGrid`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.
